run_reward_example_cli: run the reward example CLI to load and print reward data from a SQLite metadata file
query_episodes_with_rewards: query episodes joined with reward sequences from the metadata SQLite database using SQLAlchemy
read_reward_values_as_numpy: read reward sequence values from the database as a numpy float32 array
configure_metadata_path: configure the path to the metadata SQLite file using the --metadata flag
print_episode_reward_info: print episode ID, data path, reward type, and reward values for each episode
